definitions.explanation: Sound recorded or played back on a single channel, as opposed to stereo. The same signal comes from every speaker.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{録音|ろくおん}はモノラルだ。
このラジオはモノラルなので{音|おと}が{広|ひろ}がらない。
examples.english: This radio is mono, so the sound doesn't spread out.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}のテレビ{放送|ほうそう}はモノラルからステレオへと{変|か}わっていった。
examples.english: Television broadcasts of the past gradually changed from mono to stereo.

notes:
Borrowed from English "monaural." Describes single-channel sound; the opposite of ステレオ (stereo).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- モノラル{録音|ろくおん}: a mono recording
- モノラル{放送|ほうそう}: a mono broadcast

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ステレオ: stereo — two or more channels giving a sense of left-right space and width
- サラウンド: surround sound — multiple channels placed around the listener
